ns2:section.sectionText: This section will have distributed classroom attendance with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email from your instructor with specific attendance directives. Prerequisites will be enforced. This course will open to Business Administration majors on Monday, May 4, 2020 around 10:00am. This course will open to all students in Gies College of Business on Monday, May 11, 2020 around 10:00am. This section will open to ILEE students on Monday, May 18, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
